WHAT: Evaluation methodology for Fashion Finder search quality loop
HOW: Use Gemini 2.0 Flash vision to compare Chrome screenshot of 20 Vinted results against reference-photo.jpg
SCRIPT: scripts/eval-match.ts — takes item name + reference photo path + results screenshot path, sends both to Gemini, returns score and per-item feedback
REFERENCE PHOTO: /Users/ned/Desktop/Projects/vinted-fashion-finder/reference-photo.jpg (the spring parisian trench coat outfit)
GEMINI KEY: Already in .env as GEMINI_API_KEY
WORKFLOW: Chrome screenshot of results → npx tsx scripts/eval-match.ts 'polo' reference-photo.jpg /tmp/results.png → read feedback → fix prompt/query → rescan → repeat
STATUS: Script built but ralph-loop skill failed to run due to bash permission check. Needs to be manually triggered.
